//:
Bildene til kapittel én. Prompten ligger her og ikke i hodet på den som kjørte den, slik at 'hva ba vi om' overlever personen som ba. Kapittel én er et bildekapittel: det har ingen steder å vise, så det er disse tolv som bærer skjermen. Ingen av dem har tekst i seg, og ingen av dem later som de er et bestemt bryggeri — se `omits` på hver enkelt.

  .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/gen-image.py beer --list
  .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/gen-image.py beer bygg-aker --candidates 4
  .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/gen-image.py beer --accept bygg-aker=2

fire-raavarer.prompt: four small piles arranged in a row on a plain wooden table seen from directly above: clear water in a shallow glass dish, pale golden barley grains, fresh green hop cones, and a spoonful of thick beige yeast paste, even daylight from a window, no hands in frame
fire-raavarer.style: natural light still life photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
fire-raavarer.claims: The four raw materials of nearly all beer, laid out side by side: water, malted barley, hop cones and yeast.
fire-raavarer.omits: An arrangement made for this picture, not a photograph of any brewery's stock. The yeast is shown as a paste because a single cell cannot be photographed at this scale.

glass-mot-vindu.prompt: a plain drinking glass of pale golden beer standing on a windowsill with soft daylight coming through it, fine bubbles rising, thin white foam on top, plain grey background, nothing else on the sill
glass-mot-vindu.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
glass-mot-vindu.claims: A glass of pale beer in daylight — about ninety-five per cent of it water.
glass-mot-vindu.omits: Not any identified beer, brewery or product. The glass carries no markings of any kind.

kalk-vann.prompt: clear spring water running over pale grey limestone in a shallow stream bed, the stone chalky and dry above the waterline, bright overcast daylight, close view, no sky
kalk-vann.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, cool grey palette
kalk-vann.claims: Water moving over limestone — the kind of ground that puts chalk and gypsum into a brewing well.
kalk-vann.omits: Not any identified spring, town or water source, and not the water of any particular brewery.

bygg-aker.prompt: a field of ripe barley in late summer, heads heavy and bent over, long awns catching low sunlight, seen close at ear height with the field blurred behind, warm evening light
bygg-aker.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
bygg-aker.claims: Ripe barley standing in the field, the grain nearly all beer is made from.
bygg-aker.omits: Not a photograph of any identified farm, country or growing region.

spirende-korn.prompt: a thick even layer of germinating barley grains spread across a worn stone floor, each grain showing a short pale white rootlet, a wooden rake resting on the surface, dim indoor light falling from high windows
spirende-korn.style: natural light interior photograph, muted colour, soft shadow
spirende-korn.claims: Barley part-way through malting: soaked, sprouting, and not yet dried.
spirende-korn.omits: Not any identified maltings. The floor is a composite and not a record of a real building.

malt-fargeskala.prompt: four small heaps of malted barley grains in a row on a dark slate surface, running from very pale straw through amber and deep brown to almost black, even soft daylight, seen from slightly above
malt-fargeskala.style: natural light still life photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field

title.no: Fire malter, fra lys til brent

malt-fargeskala.claims: Malt kilned to four different degrees, from pale to roasted — which is where a beer's colour comes from.
malt-fargeskala.omits: Not measured samples of any commercial malt, and the four heaps are not a standard scale. Arranged for this picture.

mesk-damp.prompt: steam rising off a thick porridge of hot crushed grain in a wide stainless steel vessel, a long wooden paddle leaning against the side, humid air, dim indoor light
mesk-damp.style: natural light interior photograph, muted colour, warm shadow
mesk-damp.claims: A mash: crushed malt stirred into hot water so that its starch is cut into sugar.
mesk-damp.omits: Not any identified brewery or vessel.

kok-fosskok.prompt: a rolling boil of amber liquid in a large copper kettle seen from above, thick steam, foam churning across the whole surface, hot orange reflected light
kok-fosskok.style: natural light interior photograph, warm colour, shallow depth of field
kok-fosskok.claims: Wort at a rolling boil — the step where hops give up their bitterness and everything alive in the liquid dies.
kok-fosskok.omits: Not any identified kettle, brewhouse or company.

humlehage.//prompt: Første versjon sa bare 'pale green cones' og modellen tegnet rakler — lange, småpiggete aks som ikke er humle. Kongleformen må beskrives, ellers gjetter den. Samme feil som druene i vinkurset.
humlehage.prompt: a corridor between two rows of hop bines trained up strings on a tall trellis, heavy clusters of pale green hop cones hanging down from the vines, each cone shaped like a small soft pine cone built of overlapping papery leaf scales, broad lobed green leaves, seen looking along the row and slightly upward, bright summer daylight
humlehage.style: natural light photograph, green palette, deep perspective
humlehage.claims: Hops grown the way they are grown: a climbing plant trained up strings, reaching full height in one summer.
humlehage.omits: Not any identified hop farm, variety or growing region.

humlekongle-snitt.//prompt: 'opened by hand' fikk modellen til å rulle sammen et blad og legge gule kuler oppi. To feil: kongla er ikke et blad, og lupulin er finkornet støv, ikke perler. Begge deler må stå i prompten.
humlekongle-snitt.prompt: a very close macro view of two pale green hop cones lying on a light stone surface, each cone built like a small soft pine cone from many overlapping papery scales, one cone split open lengthwise so the fine bright yellow powdery resin dust at the base of the scales is visible, soft even daylight, no hands in frame
humlekongle-snitt.style: macro photograph, natural light, shallow depth of field
humlekongle-snitt.claims: A hop cone opened to show the yellow lupulin inside, which carries both the bitterness and the aroma oils.
humlekongle-snitt.omits: Not any identified hop variety, and not a scientific specimen.

gjaering-skum.prompt: a deep head of thick cream-coloured foam covering the surface of a fermenting vessel, dense irregular bubbles with brown streaks across it, seen from directly above, dim cellar light
gjaering-skum.style: natural light interior photograph, muted colour, close view
gjaering-skum.claims: Beer in active fermentation, with the thick foam yeast throws up during the first days.
gjaering-skum.omits: Not any identified brewery, vessel or batch.

humle-i-kok.prompt: a handful of whole green hop cones falling into a boiling kettle of amber liquid, steam rising around them, seen from above, hot reflected light on the metal rim
humle-i-kok.style: natural light interior photograph, warm colour, motion caught mid-fall
humle-i-kok.claims: Whole hop cones being dropped into hot wort, which is the moment that decides how bitter the beer becomes.
humle-i-kok.omits: Not any identified brewery, kettle or hop variety. The liquid is not visibly at a rolling boil in the picture, and the narration is about the timing of the addition rather than the boil itself.

gjaerkake-krukke.prompt: a wide earthenware crock on a worn kitchen table holding thick pale beige yeast barm, a wooden spoon lifting some of it, dim daylight from one side, plain background
gjaerkake-krukke.style: natural light still life photograph, muted colour, soft shadow

title.no: Gjæren som ble tatt vare på

gjaerkake-krukke.claims: Yeast kept from one brew to the next as a thick barm in a crock, the way it was handled for centuries before anybody knew what it was.
gjaerkake-krukke.omits: Not a photograph of any surviving historical object, and not any identified farm or household.

bryggeri-rom.prompt: a small plain brewery room with two stainless steel vessels and a hose coiled on a wet tiled floor, daylight from a high window, nobody in the room, quiet and ordinary
bryggeri-rom.style: natural light interior photograph, muted colour, wide view
bryggeri-rom.claims: An ordinary small brewery room — the kind of building the first chapter is describing, which could stand anywhere.
bryggeri-rom.omits: Not any identified brewery, and deliberately without a sign of country or period.

bybronn.prompt: an old stone well head in a small town square, a worn iron hand pump beside it, wet cobbles, overcast daylight, no people
bybronn.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, soft grey light
bybronn.claims: A town well of the kind a brewery would have drawn its water from before anyone could change what was in it.
bybronn.omits: Not any identified town, well or period. A composite, not a record.

vorter-glass.prompt: a plain glass tumbler of cloudy warm golden-brown liquid held up against a window, thick and slightly opaque, faint steam off the surface, plain background
vorter-glass.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
vorter-glass.claims: Sweet wort drawn off the mash: cloudy, warm, and not yet beer.
vorter-glass.omits: Not any identified brewery or batch. The glass carries no markings of any kind.

estere-frukt.prompt: a still life on a pale table of one banana, a small pile of dried clove buds, a green apple, a pear and two pink roses arranged in a loose row, soft even daylight, plain background, nothing else
estere-frukt.style: natural light still life photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
estere-frukt.claims: The four smells yeast makes on its own — banana, clove, apple, pear and rose — shown as the fruits and flowers they are named after.
estere-frukt.omits: None of these is an ingredient in beer. The picture names the smells, not the recipe, and that is what the narration says.

kjeller-kald.prompt: a cold vaulted stone cellar with wooden barrels stacked along one wall, damp walls, a single dim light, cold air, nobody there
kjeller-kald.style: natural light interior photograph, cool palette, deep shadow

title.en: The cellar, where the cold is

kjeller-kald.claims: A cold stone cellar with barrels — the one thing a brewer could control before the yeast could be chosen.
kjeller-kald.omits: Not any identified cellar, brewery or period.

gjaer-torr.prompt: a heaped teaspoon of fine pale beige dried yeast granules on a dark surface, a few loose granules scattered beside it, very close macro view, soft even daylight
gjaer-torr.style: macro photograph, natural light, shallow depth of field
gjaer-torr.claims: Dried brewing yeast as it is bought and weighed — a single gram of it holds roughly twenty billion cells.
gjaer-torr.omits: Not any identified strain or brand, and the individual cells are far too small to be visible at this scale.

fire-glass-rekke.//prompt: Modellen leverte tre glass på alle tre første kandidatene. Et bilde med tre glass under setningen "det var de fire" er en telle-felle, så antallet må stå eksplisitt og hvert glass må få sin egen farge i prompten.
fire-glass-rekke.prompt: a row of exactly four plain glasses of beer standing side by side and evenly spaced on a dark wooden table, all four the same size and shape: the first very pale gold, the second amber, the third deep copper brown, the fourth opaque black, each with a white head, even soft daylight from the side, plain background
fire-glass-rekke.style: natural light still life photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field

title.en: Four colours, the same four things

fire-glass-rekke.claims: Four beers of very different colours, all four made from the same four ingredients.
fire-glass-rekke.omits: Not any identified beers, styles or breweries. The glasses carry no markings of any kind.
